dataset_name: Punjab Rabi Wheat - Real Climate + Yield Dataset

yield_source.name: Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture, India

climate_source.name: NASA POWER (Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources)

parameters.T2M: Temperature at 2 Meters (deg C) - daily mean
parameters.T2M_MAX: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum (deg C) - daily max
parameters.RH2M: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters (%) - daily mean
parameters.GWETROOT: Root Zone Soil Wetness (fraction 0-1) - daily mean

feature_engineering.avg_temperature: Mean of daily T2M over Nov-Mar
feature_engineering.max_temperature: Maximum of daily T2M_MAX during Feb-Mar (terminal period)
feature_engineering.rainfall_mm: Sum of daily PRECTOTCORR over Nov-Mar
feature_engineering.humidity_pct: Mean of daily RH2M over Nov-Mar
feature_engineering.soil_moisture_pct: Mean of daily GWETROOT over Nov-Mar × 100
feature_engineering.heat_wave_days: Count of days in Feb-Mar where T2M_MAX > 31°C
